answer_2.quote: We evaluate the accuracy of VLMs' responses to ambiguous questions based on the widely adopted VQA Score and Exact Match (EM) metrics.

answer_3.quote: In ClearVQA benchmark, GPT-4 is used to simulate the "user" role, to provide user feedback ... comparing the posed clarification questions with reference.
methods: simulated user feedback (yes/no) comparison with reference clarification question

answer_4.quote: We introduce the following criteria for human evaluation of VLMs generated clarification questions: 1) Faithfulness ... 2) Reasonableness ... 3) Clarity ... We use the harmonic mean of the three metrics mentioned above to evaluate the overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators rate each clarification question on Faithfulness, Reasonableness, and Clarity using a 1-3 scale, then compute the harmonic mean as overall quality.
